02 · THE BREAKOUT THESIS
Credible delivery beats polished aspiration. In this category, breakout content is not being driven by polished aspiration. It is being driven by creators who resolve the top objection on-camera while making the desired outcome feel specific and testable. Brands still briefing generic lifestyle content are missing the real pattern.

07 WHAT WE WOULD NOT DO
5 generic plays rejected
THE ANTI-POSITIONING BLOCK · WHAT SHARPENS THE STRATEGY
  • Brief generic lifestyle or "authentic UGC" content first
  • Optimize for follower count over pattern fit
  • Lead with polished aspiration when the category rewards credible discovery
  • Imply guaranteed outcomes or use before/after claims without substantiation
  • Position creators as a sourced or booked roster before they are actually briefed
